title: Dummy data from Master Card PDF
title_id: Data Dummy dari PDF Master Card

purpose.en: Builds dummy data in levels (Inquiry, ProDev, ProCost, CO) from new Master Card PDFs, each set with dieline, artwork and clear size. Developer tool, dummy site only.
purpose.id: Membuat data dummy berlevel (Inquiry, ProDev, ProCost, CO) dari PDF Master Card baru, tiap set punya dieline, artwork, dan ukuran yang jelas. Alat developer, hanya situs dummy.

keywords: dummy, master card, pdf, engine, level, inquiry, prodev, procost, co, data dummy, kartu induk

steps.en: Put the new Master Card PDFs in docs/attachments/mastercard and the card pictures in the extracted folder next to them (same name as the PDF).
steps.id: Taruh PDF Master Card baru di docs/attachments/mastercard dan gambar kartunya di folder extracted di sebelahnya (nama sama dengan PDF).

steps.en: Open Developer > Database > Master Card Dummy (PDF) to see how many sets are at Inquiry, ProDev, ProCost and CO now, and how many PDFs are ready to build.
steps.id: Buka Developer > Database > Master Card Dummy (PDF) untuk melihat jumlah set di Inquiry, ProDev, ProCost, dan CO saat ini, serta jumlah PDF yang siap dibuat.

steps.en: Run the command php artisan dummy:mastercard --env=mockup --levels=inquiry:2,prodev:2,procost:2,co:2 to build the new sets.
steps.id: Jalankan perintah php artisan dummy:mastercard --env=mockup --levels=inquiry:2,prodev:2,procost:2,co:2 untuk membuat set baru.

steps.en: A set at a higher level always has every level behind it. Cards without artwork, size P x L x T, knife size or material are not built; the reason is listed in the result.
steps.id: Set di level lebih maju selalu punya semua level di belakangnya. Kartu tanpa artwork, ukuran P x L x T, ukuran pisau, atau bahan tidak dibuat; alasannya tampil di hasil.
